scope: Host wall time for one million real IBM AT BIOS machine steps; snapshot/restore source is the only executable difference

input.name: IBM 5170 Rev1 BIOS 1984-01-10
input.distribution: external; ROM bytes are not stored by this repository

baselineReconstruction: Checkout candidateRevision, replace src/experimental/i80386.js with git show 5576a52:src/experimental/i80386.js; temporary baseline commit only records that replacement.
method: Alternating baseline/candidate, three pairs, Node subprocess wall time measured with Python perf_counter, identical external ROM and default bounded profile.
limitations: Single host and single BIOS workload; not general CPU or silicon timing performance.
Million-step bound ends during POST, not accepted boot.
Temporary benchmark revisions do not rebind earlier or later boot evidence.
